code:
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.graphics.tsaplots import plot_acf

r = np.log(prices).diff().dropna()

plot_acf(r, lags=20)      # near-zero at every lag
plot_acf(r**2, lags=20)   # strong, slow-decaying ACF
caption: Returns show little autocorrelation; squared returns show plenty.

code:
from scipy import stats

skewness = stats.skew(r)
excess_kurt = stats.kurtosis(r)  # already kurtosis - 3

jb_stat, jb_pvalue = stats.jarque_bera(r)
# low p-value => reject Normality
caption: Jarque-Bera formally tests what skew and excess kurtosis usually already show.
